BackstoryDef.title: Rocky crofter's child
BackstoryDef.description: Thin soil and harsh winds taught them to grow barley, onions, and whatever else stubbornly survived the islands.

BackstoryDef.title: Iron forge apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: They worked a smoky forge repairing axes, hooks, weapons, and fittings for ships that rarely stayed in harbor long.

BackstoryDef.title: Quarry thrall's child
BackstoryDef.description: Their youth was spent carrying stone and timber for keeps, docks, and coastal fortifications.

BackstoryDef.title: Bone scrimshander
BackstoryDef.description: They carved bone, horn, and driftwood into charms and decorations during long nights beside the sea.

BackstoryDef.title: Captain's fosterling
BackstoryDef.description: Sent to another household, they learned the names of captains, ships, old grudges, and which families still remembered ancient insults.

BackstoryDef.title: Salt House heir
BackstoryDef.description: Expected to inherit land and ships, they were taught stores, crews, household authority, and the traditions of the Old Way.

BackstoryDef.title: Second son of Pyke
BackstoryDef.description: With little inheritance awaiting them, the sea and the axe offered the clearest path to wealth.

BackstoryDef.title: Salt-born bastard
BackstoryDef.description: They grew up between legitimate kin, salt wives, sailors, and servants where blood mattered but strength mattered more.

BackstoryDef.title: Cliff goat herder
BackstoryDef.description: They guarded hardy animals along windswept cliffs and became a deadly shot with sling and bow.

BackstoryDef.title: Young deck fighter
BackstoryDef.description: They joined a longship young, learning how to fight on a rolling deck and bind wounds far from any maester.

BackstoryDef.title: Island crofter
BackstoryDef.description: They coaxed food from poor soil while richer Ironborn mocked farmers despite depending on their harvest.

BackstoryDef.title: Ironborn weaponsmith
BackstoryDef.description: Axes, swords, grappling hooks, and ship fittings passed constantly through their forge.

BackstoryDef.title: Longship carpenter
BackstoryDef.description: They built and repaired the vessels that carried the Ironborn to fishing grounds, trade, and war.

BackstoryDef.title: Seal hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Years hunting along dangerous coasts taught them patience, navigation, and respect for the sea.

BackstoryDef.title: Scrimshaw master
BackstoryDef.description: Their carved bone and horn depict krakens, ships, drowned men, and tales of legendary reavers.

BackstoryDef.title: Ship's healer
BackstoryDef.description: They learned to sew axe wounds and treat infected cuts while the deck pitched beneath their feet.

BackstoryDef.title: Drowned lorekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: They memorized genealogies, old raids, religious tales, and the words spoken by priests of the Drowned God.

BackstoryDef.title: Veteran reaver
BackstoryDef.description: They have boarded ships and stormed shores enough times to know that glory usually smells of salt, smoke, and blood.

BackstoryDef.title: Harbor steward
BackstoryDef.description: They managed warehouses, crews, cargo, and supplies for a captain too important to count barrels personally.

BackstoryDef.title: Captain's envoy
BackstoryDef.description: They negotiated ransoms, trade, docking rights, and uneasy agreements with mainlanders who seldom trusted Ironborn promises.
